prompt:
Edit the supplied pixel-art homepage hero to give it a clear but gentle FEDIVERSE / connected universe context. Preserve the exact friendly orange and blue elephant mascots, their round upright bodies, tiny eyes, white smiling tusks, familiar colors and their central action of sharing ONE ordinary bowl of warm rice. Keep both characters complete and recognizable in the center foreground.

Recompose in 3:2 landscape. Reduce the pair slightly so they occupy about 60 percent of the image width and 65 percent of height, leaving room AROUND AND ABOVE them for a connected star neighborhood. They are together on one subtle small pale blue crescent-shaped local world / softly suggested ground at bottom center, NOT giant bowls or elaborate floating gardens.

In the surrounding background add FIVE small, distinct, softly colored inhabited-looking round planets at varied distances: pale sage, muted lilac, dusty blue, soft peach, and a tiny ringed planet. Place planets around the upper left, upper center, upper right and far sides, NEVER over the characters or rice bowl. One or two distant planets may have a tiny simplified house or tree, suggesting separate communities, but keep them tiny and restrained. Connect the planets to each other and to the pair's local world using thin pale-blue curved dotted orbital/message routes. Paths form a loose network with multiple nodes, NOT just one large decorative ring. Add a few little bright cream / blue pixel message sparks along the paths and a single tiny paper airplane crossing one distant route. Rice steam gently becomes a few small star pixels and joins the network. This should visually say "friends sharing everyday life in one community, connected to many other communities".

Calm spacious powder-blue celestial patch behind the upper network, softly tapering into warm ivory #fffdf3 around the outside edges and lower foreground so the illustration blends into an ivory webpage. Only sparse pixel stars, no solid dark rectangle, no dramatic sci-fi galaxy, no neon, no dense cosmic texture. Keep warm intimate daily-life feeling. Main mascots and rice remain most prominent; planets and routes occupy background hierarchy. Real deliberate 16-bit pixel art, consistent stepped silhouettes, limited color clusters, restrained flat shading, no blur or glossy 3D. NO TEXT, labels, letters, logos, speech bubbles, UI or frame. No extra elephants or extra bowls. No realistic mammoths, no fur, no trees blocking characters, no complete meal table, no giant bowls-as-planets.
